effect:
Extends duration of barrier moves.

Light Clay will increase how long Light Screen and Reflect last from 5 turns to 8 turns! Those extra turns of damage reduction can make a huge difference esp if you are switching out for other Pokémon.

This is a go-to item for dedicated screen setters. Having 8 turns of screens instead of 5 means your sweepers have way more time to set up and attack behind the protection. A staple for hyper offense teams.
